findings.advice: Output drifting down 13% over a dry spell: dust build-up. Clean the panels.
Output is steady near half of expected on sunny days: one string is likely dead. Check the DC isolator, MC4 connectors and string fuse.
Consistently low even on sunny days with no dust pattern. Check for new shadows (water tank, tree, neighbour's floor) or module degradation.
